## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the related issue if applicable.

## Verification

Describe the checks performed and their results. Include the Cloudflare preview URL when available. Record any verification that could not be completed.

## Review and merge

- [ ] The diff is focused and contains no credentials, personal data or unpublished research material.
- [ ] Relevant links, assets and affected behavior have been checked.
- [ ] Version claims and download availability match the documented distribution status; no withheld application source, ZIPs or real datasets are included.
- [ ] For interface changes, keyboard access and narrow-screen behavior have been checked, or limitations are recorded above.
- [ ] Codex bot has completed review of the latest changes. Request `@codex review` when needed.
- [ ] Review findings have been addressed and the resulting changes verified.
- [ ] The maintainer has explicitly authorized merging.

An AI summary comment records review completion but does not by itself constitute GitHub Approve. Complete any additional required checks or approvals before merging.
